title: Cross-Attention
interviewAnswer: Cross-attention uses queries from one sequence and keys/values from another, letting one representation retrieve information from a different encoder or modality.
why: Cross-attention is fundamental to encoder-decoder, multimodal and conditioned generative systems.
intuition: The decoder asks questions while another representation supplies keys and values.
deepDive: The same scaled dot-product operation is used, but Q and K/V come from different tensors/sequences.
production: Long conditioning contexts can dominate memory/latency; profile them.
workedExample: Image latents can query text embeddings in text-conditioned generation.
